z-m-20-01.title: Ma wadarka laba tibaax oo laba-jibbaaran had iyo jeer waa tibaax laba-jibbaaran?
z-m-20-01.topic: Darajada tibaax-badan: isku darka iyo ku dhufashada
z-m-20-01.goal: Sharax sida darajadu u beddelanto wadarta iyo wax-ku-dhufashada tibaax-badan, adigoo kala sooca kiisaska tusaalayaal lid ku ah iyo sababo.
z-m-20-01.material: Tibaax-badan A iyo B labaduba waa tibaaxyo jajab-labaad ah oo x ku jira. Taasi micnaheedu waa isku-dhufashada x² maaha 0 (loo akhriyo: x² waa "x labajibbaaran"), dhammaan isku-dhufashooyinkuna waa tirooyin dhab ah. Darajadu waa darajada eraygii ugu sarreeyay ee isku-dhufashadiisu aan 0 ahayn. Tusaale ahaan, x²+3x waa tibaax jajab-labaad ah 2-na waxay leedahay daraja 0. Ma tixgelinayno kiiska A+B ama A−B laftiisa uu yahay 0. Seoyeon ayaa yidhi, "Haddii aad isku darto tibaaxyo jajab-labaad ah, waxaad heshaa tibaax jajab-labaad ah, haddii aad ku dhufatana, waxaad heshaa tibaax daraja-4 ah."
z-m-20-01.thinking.0: Tijaabinta sheegashada "had iyo jeer" adigoo isticmaalaya tusaale lid ku ah
z-m-20-01.thinking.1: Isbarbar dhig wadarta iyo wax-ku-dhufashada oo ka sababee kee ayaa lumin kara eraygiisa darajada ugu sarreysa
z-m-20-01.thinking.2: Naqshadee tusaalayaal adigu leh oo buuxiya shuruudaha
z-m-20-01.prereq.0: H1 ee hawshani wuxuu calaamadeeyaa heerka adkaanta iyo taageerada ee ururkan soo saarka oo keliya; maaha qoondayn fasal ee manhajka. U malee inaad taqaanid isku darka, ka jarista iyo ku dhufashada tibaax-badan ee dugsiga dhexe, qaababka ku dhufashada, iyo qaybinta aasaasiga ah.
z-m-20-01.prereq.1: Micnaha darajada iyo eraygii darajada ugu sarreysa ee tibaax-badan
z-m-20-01.prereq.2: Wax-ku-dhufashada laba tiro oo aan eber ahayn maaha 0
z-m-20-01.s.s1.prompt: Marka A iyo B ay yihiin tibaaxyo jajab-labaad ah oo buuxiya shuruudda kor ku xusan, dooro dhammaan bayaannada had iyo jeer run ah laba tibaax jajab-labaad ah oo aad doortid ha noqdaane.
z-m-20-01.s.s1.hint.0: Haddii bayaan uu had iyo jeer run yahay, waa inuu ku habboon yahay lammaane kasta oo tibaaxyo jajab-labaad ah oo aad geliso. Dooro laba tibaax jajab-labaad oo fudud, isku dar oo ku dhufo, oo hubi darajada.
z-m-20-01.s.s1.hint.1: Weedh kasta, isku day inaad doorato A iyo B ka dhigaya weedhaas mid been ah, haddii aadan dooran karin-na, qor sababta aadan u dooran karin.
z-m-20-01.s.s1.o.a: A+B had iyo jeer waa tibaax jajab-labaad ah.
z-m-20-01.s.s1.r.a: Waxaad tidhi "had iyo jeer" adigoon tijaabin kiiska halka wadarta isku-dhufashooyinka x² ay tahay 0.
z-m-20-01.s.s1.r.b: Xukunkani wuxuu arkaa in isku darku kaliya ku darayo isku-dhufashooyinka erayada isla darajada, sidaas darteed eray cusub oo daraja sare ah ma soo baxo.
z-m-20-01.s.s1.o.c: A×B had iyo jeer waa tibaax daraja-4 ah.
z-m-20-01.s.s1.r.c: Xukunkani wuxuu tixgelinayaa laba eray kee ayaa isku dhufta si ay u sameeyaan eraygii darajada ugu sarreysa ee wax-ku-dhufashada.
z-m-20-01.s.s1.o.d: Darajada A−B had iyo jeer waa ka yar tahay 2.
z-m-20-01.s.s1.r.d: Waxaad u malaysay eraygii darajada ugu sarreysa inuu baaba'o marka aad ka jarto. Wuxuu baabaa'aa kaliya marka labada isku-dhufasho x² ay isle'eg yihiin. Tusaale ahaan, haddii A=x² iyo B=2x², markaas A−B=−x².
z-m-20-01.s.s1.o.e: Isku-dhufashada eraygii x⁴ ee A×B wuxuu noqon karaa 0.
z-m-20-01.s.s1.r.e: Waxaad ku dhacda wadarta u gudbisay wax-ku-dhufashada sidiisa. Ka fikir sida isku-dhufashada eraygii darajada ugu sarreysa ee wax-ku-dhufashada loo sameeyo.
z-m-20-01.s.s1.explain: b iyo c waxay run yihiin lammaane kasta oo tibaaxyo jajab-labaad ah. a wuu jabaa marka wadarta labada isku-dhufasho x² ay tahay 0, d-na wuu jabaa marka labada isku-dhufasho x² ay kala duwan yihiin. Sababta e u run aysan ahayn waa wax aad adigu sharixi doonto tallaabada ugu dambeysa.
z-m-20-01.s.s2.prompt: Ha noqdaan A=ax²+bx+1 iyo B=cx²+dx+2 (a, b, c, d waa tirooyin dhab ah). Samee laba tusaale oo leh tibaaxyo kala duwan halka A iyo B labaduba yihiin tibaaxyo jajab-labaad ah laakiin A+B uusan ahayn tibaax jajab-labaad ah.
z-m-20-01.s.s2.hint.0: Marka hore qor sida isku-dhufashada eraygii x² ee A+B loo muujin karo adigoo isticmaalaya a iyo c.
z-m-20-01.s.s2.hint.1: Dooro a si isku-dhufashadani u noqoto 0 oo c ula mid ka dhig. Kadibna si xor ah u dooro b iyo d oo isku dar si aad u hubiso.
z-m-20-01.s.s2.fail.c1: Haddii isku-dhufashada x² a ee A uu yahay 0, markaas A maaha tibaax jajab-labaad ah.
z-m-20-01.s.s2.fail.c2: Haddii isku-dhufashada x² c ee B uu yahay 0, markaas B maaha tibaax jajab-labaad ah.
z-m-20-01.s.s2.fail.c3: Weli erey x² ayaa ku hadhay A+B. Hel isku-dhufashada x² ee A+B oo hubi.
z-m-20-01.s.s2.explain: Tusaale ahaan, haddii A=x²+2x+1 iyo B=−x²+5x+2, markaas A+B=7x+3, taasoo ah tibaax toosan. Haddii A=2x²+3x+1 iyo B=−2x²+3x+2, markaas A+B=6x+3. Labada tibaaxba waa jajab-labaad, laakiin haddii wadarta isku-dhufashooyinka x² ay tahay 0, wadartu maaha tibaax jajab-labaad ah. Sidaas darteed "isku darka tibaaxyo jajab-labaad waxay bixisaa tibaax jajab-labaad" had iyo jeer run ma aha.
z-m-20-01.s.s3.prompt: Sheegashooyinka Seoyeon dhexdooda, "isku darku wuxuu bixiyaa tibaax jajab-labaad" way jabtay, laakiin "ku dhufashadu wuxuu bixisaa tibaax daraja-4 ah" ma jabin. Erayadaada ku qor sababta eraygii darajada ugu sarreysa wax-ku-dhufashada uusan u baaba'in karin, adigoo la barbar dhigaya wadarta.
z-m-20-01.s.s3.hint.0: Hel kee eray oo A ka mid ah iyo kee eray oo B ka mid ah waa inay isku dhufataan si ay u sameeyaan eraygii x⁴ ee A×B.
z-m-20-01.s.s3.hint.1: Isku-dhufashada x² ee A+B waa a+c. Qor sida isku-dhufashada x⁴ ee A×B u soo baxo, oo isbarbar dhig labada.
z-m-20-01.s.s3.selfAssess.0: Ma ku qortay erayadaada sababta eraygii darajada ugu sarreysa wadarta ugu baaba'i karo (isku-dhufashooyinku waxay isu darsamaan 0)?
z-m-20-01.s.s3.selfAssess.1: Ma qortay laba eray kee ayaa isku dhufta si ay u sameeyaan eraygii darajada ugu sarreysa ee wax-ku-dhufashada?
z-m-20-01.s.s3.selfAssess.2: Ma isticmaashay xaqiiqada ah wax-ku-dhufashada laba tiro oo aan eber ahayn maaha 0 sida sabab?
z-m-20-01.s.s3.model.0: Wadarta, waxaan ku darnaa isku-dhufashooyinka x², a+c-na wuxuu noqon karaa 0, sidaas darteed eraygii x² wuu baaba'i karaa. Wax-ku-dhufashada, isku-dhufashada eraygii darajada ugu sarreysa waa ac, wax-ku-dhufashada a iyo c. Haddii a iyo c labaduba aan 0 ahayn, ac sidoo kale 0 ma aha, sidaas darteed eraygii x⁴ had iyo jeer wuu hadhaa.
z-m-20-01.s.s3.model.1: Marka aan ku dhufanno, wax-ku-dhufashada erayada darajada ugu sarreysa waa eraygii x⁴, taasna waa wax-ku-dhufashada keliya ee sameeya eray x⁴, sidaas darteed eray kale ma tirtiri karo. Isku-dhufashaduna waa wax-ku-dhufasho tirooyin aan eber ahayn, sidaas darteed maaha 0. Wadarta, + iyo − way kulmi karaan oo samayn karaan 0, sidaas darteed eray wuu baaba'i karaa, laakiin tani wax-ku-dhufashada kuma dhacdo.
z-m-20-01.s.s3.model.2: Tusaale ahaan, (x²+1)(−x²+2), eraygii x⁴ ee keliya waa x²×(−x²)=−x⁴, isku-dhufashadiisa −1 na maaha 0, sidaa darteed waa tibaax darajo-4 ah. Wadarka (x²+1)+(−x²+2), isku-dhufashada x² waa 1+(−1)=0, sidaa darteed eraygii x² wuu baaba'ay.
z-m-20-01.s.s3.modelNote.2: Jawaab lagu sharaxay tibaaxo gaar ah sidoo kale waa ansax.

z-m-20-02.title: Tibaaxda kee ayaa qiimaheeda lagu go'aamiyey wadarka oo keliya?
z-m-20-02.topic: Qaacidooyinka isku-dhufashada iyo qiimayaasha tibaaxaha: laba tiro oo wadar la bixiyey leh
z-m-20-02.goal: Go'aami tibaaxda kee leh hal qiime marka wadarka a+b ee laba tiro uu keliya la yaqaan, oo kala saar macluumaad dheeraad ah oo ku filan iyo kan aan ku filnayn si loo go'aamiyo qiimaha.
z-m-20-02.material: Laba tiro dhab ah a iyo b, wax aad ogtahay waa a+b=6 oo keliya. Wax sheegaya in a iyo b ay yihiin tirooyin dhan ma jiro, wax sheegaya inay yihiin togan na ma jiro. Waxaan rabnaa inaan aragno qiimayaasha tibaaxaha kee ayaan heli karnaa adigoon helin a iyo b si gooni ah. Akhriska: a² waa "a labajibbaaran", ab waa "a jeer b", a³ na waa "a saddexjibbaaran".
z-m-20-02.thinking.1: Naftaada samaynta tusaalayaal lid ku ah (isla wadar, qiimayaal kala duwan)
z-m-20-02.thinking.2: Isbarbar dhigga intee le'eg ayay macluumaadka dheeraadka ahi ku filan yihiin
z-m-20-02.thinking.3: Sharaxaadda gunaanad shuruud leh (labajibbaarku waa go'an yahay laakiin calaamaddu maaha)
z-m-20-02.prereq.3: Khibrad beddelidda tibaaxo adigoon helin qiimayaasha tirooyinka dhabta ah ee a iyo b si gooni ah
z-m-20-02.s.s1.prompt: Dooro dhammaan tibaaxaha qiimahoodu lagu go'aamiyey hal qiime xaqiiqada a+b=6 oo keliya.
z-m-20-02.s.s1.hint.0: Tibaax kasta oo aad doorato, geli laba lammaane oo kala duwan (a, b) oo buuxiya a+b=6 oo isbarbar dhig haddii qiimayaashu isku mid yihiin.
z-m-20-02.s.s1.hint.1: Tibaaxaha qiimayaashoodu isku mid yihiin, hubi haddii aad ku kooxayn karto si a+b ay ugu muuqato tibaaxda sida ay tahay.
z-m-20-02.s.s1.r.a: Qiimuhu wuu is beddeli karaa iyadoo ku xidhan sida a iyo b wadarka u qaybsadaan, adigana ma tijaabin tan. Geli a=3, b=3 iyo a=0, b=6 oo isbarbar dhig.
z-m-20-02.s.s1.r.b: Xukunkani wuxuu arkaa in wadarka a+b ay ku jirto tibaaxda sida hal xirmo.
z-m-20-02.s.s1.r.c: Xataa isla wadar, calaamadda farqigu way is beddeli kartaa iyadoo ku xidhan haddii a ka weyn yahay ama b ka weyn yahay, adiguna waad seegtay.
z-m-20-02.s.s1.r.d: Xukunkani wuxuu u aqoonsaday tibaaxda sida qaabka qaacidada isku-dhufashada.
z-m-20-02.s.s1.r.e: 2a+2b waa go'an yahay laakiin a²+b² maaha, sidaa darteed wadarku sidoo kale go'an ma aha. Waxaad u malaysay haddii hal qayb go'an tahay, dhammaan waa go'an yahay.
z-m-20-02.s.s1.explain: 2a+2b=2(a+b)=12 iyo a²+2ab+b²=(a+b)²=36. a²+b² waa 18 haddii a=3, b=3 iyo 36 haddii a=0, b=6, sidaa darteed go'an maaha. a−b sidoo kale waa 2 haddii a=4, b=2 iyo −2 haddii a=2, b=4.
z-m-20-02.s.s2.prompt: Samee saddex lammaane (a, b) leh a+b=6 oo qiimayaasha a²+b² dhammaantood kala duwan yihiin. (a, b) iyo (b, a) waxay tiriyaan isla lammaane.
z-m-20-02.s.s2.hint.0: Marka hore dooro a, b ka dhig 6−a, kadibna si toos ah u xisaabi a²+b².
z-m-20-02.s.s2.hint.1: Si aad u aragto haddii qiimayaashu kala duwan yihiin, dooro qiimayaal a oo kala duwan, sida 0, 1, 2, oo isbarbar dhig.
z-m-20-02.s.s2.fail.c1: a+b maaha 6. Isku dar labada tiro oo hubi.
z-m-20-02.s.s2.explain: (1, 5), a²+b²=26; (2, 4), waa 20; (3, 3), waa 18; (0, 6) na, waa 36. Xataa isla wadar, qiimayaasha a²+b² way kala duwan yihiin. (1, 5) iyo (5, 1) waxay leeyihiin isla a²+b², sidaa darteed waxay tiriyaan isla tusaale.
z-m-20-02.s.s3.prompt: Marka lagu daro a+b=6, shuruudahan hoose kee ayaa qiimaha a²+b² u go'aamin lahaa hal qiime? Dooro dhammaan kuwa ku filan. (a iyo b waa tirooyin dhab ah)
z-m-20-02.s.s3.hint.0: Doorasho kasta, ka fikir haddii shuruuddaas iyo a+b=6 ay kuu oggolaanayaan inaad hesho a, b, ama ab.
z-m-20-02.s.s3.hint.1: Shuruud aan musharraxiinta u cidhiidhin hal, hubi haddii laba lammaane oo leh a²+b² kala duwan (tusaale ahaan, (1, 5) iyo (2, 4)) labaduba buuxiyaan shuruuddaas.
z-m-20-02.s.s3.r.a: Haddii a uu yahay tiro dhan, suurtagalnimo badan ayaa hadha, sida a=1 iyo a=2, adiguna ma tijaabin haddii qiimaha la go'aamiyey.
z-m-20-02.s.s3.r.b: Xukunkani wuxuu arkaa in haddii aad ogaato wadarka iyo wax-soo-saarka labadaba, aad u muujin karto a²+b² adigoo isticmaalaya wadarka iyo wax-soo-saarka.
z-m-20-02.s.s3.r.c: Shuruud calaamad ayaa yaraysa musharraxiinta laakiin u cidhiidhin hal. a=1, b=5 iyo a=2, b=4 labaduba waa togan yihiin.
z-m-20-02.s.s3.r.d: Xukunkani wuxuu isticmaalaa xaqiiqada ah in haddii aad ogaato a+b iyo a−b, aad heli karto a iyo b si gooni ah.
z-m-20-02.s.s3.r.e: Xukunkani wuxuu arkaa in wadarka saddexjibbaarrada sidoo kale loo muujin karo wadarka iyo wax-soo-saarka, sidaa darteed wax-soo-saarka ab waa la heli karaa.
z-m-20-02.s.s3.explain: Haddii ab=8, markaas a²+b²=(a+b)²−2ab=36−16=20. Haddii a−b=2, markaas a=4 iyo b=2, sidaa darteed waa 20. Laga bilaabo a³+b³=(a+b)³−3ab(a+b)=216−18ab=144, waxaan helnaa ab=4, sidaa darteed a²+b²=36−8=28. Shuruud sida in la dhan yahay ama togan tahay waxay yaraysaa musharraxiinta oo keliya mana u cidhiidhiso hal.
z-m-20-02.s.s4.prompt: Marka a+b=6 iyo ab=8, saaxiib ayaa yiri, "a−b sidoo kale waxaa lagu go'aamiyey hal qiime." Ma ku raacsan tahay? Qor jawaabtaada adigoo sababo bixinaya.
z-m-20-02.s.s4.hint.0: Hel laba tiro oo gaar ah oo wadarkoodu yahay 6 wax-soo-saarkoodu na yahay 8, oo xisaabi a−b.
z-m-20-02.s.s4.hint.1: Isbarbar dhig waxa dhaca a−b haddii aad is-weydaarsiiso magacyada a iyo b ee labada tiro ee aad heshay.
z-m-20-02.s.s4.placeholder: tusaale, Haddii a+b=6 iyo ab=8, markaas ...
z-m-20-02.s.s4.selfAssess.0: Ma bixisay sabab adigoo sheegaya waxa (a−b)² yahay, ama adigoo isticmaalaya lammaanayaal gaar ah sida a=4, b=2 iyo a=2, b=4?
z-m-20-02.s.s4.selfAssess.1: Ma si cad u qortay in a−b uu yeelan karo laba qiime (calaamadda)?
z-m-20-02.s.s4.selfAssess.2: Ma kala saartay in labajibbaarka (a−b)² uu go'an yahay laakiin a−b laftiisu go'an maaha?
z-m-20-02.s.s4.model.0: Ma ku raacsani. (a−b)²=(a+b)²−4ab=36−32=4, sidaa darteed a−b waa 2 ama −2. Kee ayaa ah wuxuu ku xidhan yahay kala horreynta a iyo b, sidaa darteed hal qiime lagu go'aamin maayo.
z-m-20-02.s.s4.model.1: Haddii a=4, b=2, markaas a−b=2, haddii a=2, b=4 na, a−b=−2, labada xaaladoodba wadarku waa 6 wax-soo-saarkuna waa 8. Sidaa darteed a−b hal qiime lagu go'aamin maayo, labajibbaarka (a−b)²=4 oo keliya ayaa go'an.
z-m-20-02.s.s4.model.2: Kaliya qiimaha saxda ah 2 ayaa go'an. Xataa haddii wadarka iyo wax-soo-saarka isku mid yihiin, is-weydaarsiga a iyo b wuxuu beddelaa calaamadda a−b, sidaa darteed −2 sidoo kale waa suurtagal, hal qiime oo keliya maaha.
z-m-20-02.s.s4.model.3: Ma ku raacsani. a−b waa 2 ama −2. Kaliya (a−b)²=4 ayaa la go'aamiyey.

z-m-20-05.title: Maxaan ka ogaan karnaa isugeynta annagoo aan balaadhin?
z-m-20-05.topic: Helidda wadarrada isugeynta adoo qiyamka x gelinaya
z-m-20-05.goal: Annagoo aan balaadhin tibaaxda, kala sooc macluumaadka ku saabsan isugeynta ee aad ka ogaan karto qiyamka marka x=0, 1, −1 iyo macluumaadka aadan ogaan karin, hel oo sax khalad xal, oo muuji in dhowr polynomial ay leeyihiin isla macluumaad.
z-m-20-05.material: Haddii aad gabi ahaanba balaadhiso P(x)=(x²−x−1)³, waxay noqotaa tibaax darajo-6 ah oo leh xubno laga bilaabo x⁶ ilaa joogtada. Akhrinta: P(x) waa "x labajibbaaran laga jaro x laga jaro 1, qaubka dhexdooda, saddex-jibbaar". Waxaan rabnaa inaan macluumaad ka helno isugeynta annagoo aan balaadhin. P(0), P(1), iyo P(−1) si fudud ayaa loo heli karaa adoo si toos ah ugu gelinaya qaubka. Waxaan qori doonaa tibaaxda la balaadhiyay sida P(x)=a₆x⁶+a₅x⁵+a₄x⁴+a₃x³+a₂x²+a₁x+a₀ (akhrinta: a₆ waa "a lix," lambarka hoose-na waa magac muujinaya darajada).
z-m-20-05.thinking.0: Fasiridda isku-darka isugeynta ee qiimaha la geliyay yahay
z-m-20-05.thinking.1: Helidda iyo saxidda sadarka khaldan ee xal
z-m-20-05.thinking.2: Naqshadaynta dhowr polynomial oo buuxiya isla shuruudaha
z-m-20-05.thinking.3: Sharaxaadda sababta macluumaadku u ku filnayn
z-m-20-05.prereq.1: Macnaha qiimaha marka x=1, x=−1, x=0 la geliyo polynomial (qiimaha polynomial)
z-m-20-05.prereq.3: Xallinta isla'egyo isku-xiran adoo isku darayo oo ka jarayo
z-m-20-05.s.s1.prompt: Dooro wax kasta oo aad heli karto adoo saddexda qiimood P(0), P(1), P(−1) oo keliya isticmaalaya (annagoo aan balaadhin).
z-m-20-05.s.s1.hint.0: Qor qiimaha xubin kasta aₖxᵏ noqonayso marka aad x u geliso 0, 1, −1, adoo kala saaraya xaaladda k labood ah iyo xaaladda k dhiman tahay.
z-m-20-05.s.s1.hint.1: Doorasho kasta, qor isku-darka saddexda qiimood P(0), P(1), P(−1) ee bixiya qiimahaas, haddii aan la muujin karin, samee tusaale lid ku ah adoo polynomial fudud isticmaalaya.
z-m-20-05.s.s1.o.a: Qiimaha isugeynta keliya ee a₃ ee x³
z-m-20-05.s.s1.r.a: Saddexda qiimood waa macluumaad ku saabsan wadarrada isugeynta qaarkood oo keliya. Ma tijaabin haddii isugeynta hal xubin si gooni ah loo ogaan karo.
z-m-20-05.s.s1.r.b: Go'aankani wuxuu eegayaa xubinta hadhay marka aad x u geliso 0.
z-m-20-05.s.s1.r.c: Go'aankani wuxuu arkaa sida calaamadaha xubnaha darajada dhiman ay ugu kala duwan yihiin x=1 iyo x=−1.
z-m-20-05.s.s1.o.d: Isugeynta a₆ ee x⁶ (isugeynta xubinta darajada ugu sarreysa)
z-m-20-05.s.s1.r.d: Waxaad ogaan kartaa xubinta darajada ugu sarreysa adoo eegaya qaab-dhismeedka tibaaxda, laakiin saddexdan qiimood oo keliya ma hagaajiyaan. Ma kala saartay macluumaadka dhibaatadu oggolaato.
z-m-20-05.s.s1.r.e: Go'aankani wuxuu arkaa marka aad x=1 gelisid, awood kasta oo x ah wuxuu noqdaa 1.
z-m-20-05.s.s1.explain: P(0)=a₀, P(1)=wadarta dhammaan isugeynta, iyo P(1)−P(−1)=2(wadarta isugeynta xubnaha darajada dhiman). Isugeynta a₃ ee hal xubin ama isugeynta a₆ ee xubinta darajada ugu sarreysa saddexdan qiimood oo keliya looma hagaajiyo (haddii aad si toos ah u eegto qaab-dhismeedka, waxaad arki kartaa in a₆=1, laakiin tani waa macluumaad ka duwan).
z-m-20-05.s.s2.prompt: Arday ayaa helay wadarta isugeynta xubnaha darajada labood iyo wadarta isugeynta xubnaha darajada dhiman. Dooro hal sadar oo khaldan.
z-m-20-05.s.s2.hint.0: Ka jar tibaaxda leh x=−1 la geliyay tibaaxda leh x=1 la geliyay, oo si toos ah u eeg xubnaha hadhay iyo kuwa baxay.
z-m-20-05.s.s2.hint.1: Eeg isugeynta xubnaha hadhay hortooda oo ku is barbar dhig wadarta aad rabto inaad hesho.
z-m-20-05.s.s2.line.3: Ku darista labada isla'eg waxay bixisaa 2(a₆+a₄+a₂+a₀)=0, sidaas darteed wadarta isugeynta xubnaha darajada labood waa 0.
z-m-20-05.s.s2.line.4: Ka jarista labada isla'eg waxay bixisaa in wadarta isugeynta xubnaha darajada dhiman ay tahay (−1)−1=−2.
z-m-20-05.s.s2.explain: Sadarka 5 waa khalad. Ka jarista isla'egta labaad tan koowaad waxay bixisaa 2(a₅+a₃+a₁)=−1−1=−2, sidaas darteed wadarta isugeynta xubnaha darajada dhiman waa −1. Sadarrada 1 ilaa 4 waa sax. Xubnaha darajada labood waxaa ku jira joogtada a₀.
z-m-20-05.s.s3.prompt: Tibaaxda saddex-jibbaarka ah Q(x)=ax³+bx²+cx+d (a, b, c, d waa tirooyin dhan, a≠0), samee saddex Q oo kala duwan oo wadarta dhammaan isugeynta ay tahay 0 wadarta isugeynta xubnaha darajada dhimanna ay tahay 2.
z-m-20-05.s.s3.hint.0: Marka hore dooro a si wadarta labada isugeyn ee xubnaha darajada dhiman ay u noqoto 2, ka dibna waafaq c.
z-m-20-05.s.s3.hint.1: Kadibna xisaabi waxa wadarta labada isugeyn ee hadhay b iyo d ay tahay inay noqoto si wadarta dhammaan isugeynta ay u noqoto 0.
z-m-20-05.s.s3.fail.c1: Haddii a uu yahay 0, ma aha tibaax saddex-jibbaar ah.
z-m-20-05.s.s3.fail.c2: Fadlan ka dhig dhammaan isugeynta tirooyin dhan.
z-m-20-05.s.s3.ok.c4: Wadarta isugeynta xubnaha darajada dhiman waa 2.
z-m-20-05.s.s3.fail.c4: Wadarta isugeynta xubnaha darajada dhiman (x³, x) ma aha 2.
z-m-20-05.s.s3.explain: Tusaale ahaan, x³+x−2 wuxuu leeyahay wadarta isugeynta 1+1−2=0 wadarta isugeynta darajada dhiman-na waa 1+1=2. 2x³−x²−1 sidoo kale wadartiisu waa 0 darajada dhiman-na wadartiisu waa 2. Waxaa jira dhowr tibaax saddex-jibbaar ah oo leh isla labada macluumaad.
z-m-20-05.s.s4.prompt: Q oo kala duwan ee aad ka samaysay s3 dhammaantood waxay leeyihiin isla labada macluumaad (wadarta isugeynta 0, wadarta darajada dhiman 2). Qor sababta labadan macluumaad oo keliya aysan u hagaajin tibaaxda saddex-jibbaarka hal, oo qiyaas oo qor waxa dheeraad ah ee loo baahan yahay si loo hagaajiyo hal.
z-m-20-05.s.s4.hint.0: Jadwal ku habee kuwee ka mid ah a, b, c, d ayaa ku kala duwan Q aad samaysay.
z-m-20-05.s.s4.hint.1: Tiri tirada isugeynta iyo tirada isla'egyada labada shuruudood, oo is barbar dhig.
z-m-20-05.s.s4.placeholder: Tusaale: Waxaa jira ... isugeyn laakiin macluumaadku waa ...
z-m-20-05.s.s4.selfAssess.0: Ma is barbar dhigtay oo qortay imisa isugeyn ayaa jira iyo imisa qaybood oo macluumaad ah (isla'egyo)?
z-m-20-05.s.s4.selfAssess.1: Ma isticmaashay Q kala duwan ee aad samaysay sidii caddayn?
z-m-20-05.s.s4.selfAssess.2: Ma magacawday macluumaadka dheeraadka ah ee loo baahan yahay adoo tusaale gaar ah isticmaalaya (tusaale, qiimaha Q(2) ama qiimaha a)?
z-m-20-05.s.s4.model.0: Waxaa jira afar isugeyn a, b, c, d, laakiin waxaa jira laba isla'eg oo keliya, a+b+c+d=0 iyo a+c=2. Sidaas darteed haddii aad hagaajiso a, c way raacdaa, b iyo d-na wadartooda oo keliya ayaa la hagaajiyay, sidaas darteed waxaa jiri kara kuwo badan, sida x³+x−2 iyo 2x³−x²−1. Waxaan u baahanahay laba isla'eg oo kale.
z-m-20-05.s.s4.model.1: Macluumaadku waa laba wadar, sidaas darteed isugeyn kasta lama hagaajiyo. Tusaale ahaan, haddii a=1 markaas c=1, haddii a=2 markaas c=0, sidaas darteed tibaaxo kala duwan ayaa soo baxa. Waxaan u baahanahay shuruudo dheeraad ah, sida qiimaha Q(2) ama qiimaha a, xataa markaas hal kale ayaa loo baahan yahay si loo hagaajiyo b iyo d.
z-m-20-05.s.s4.modelNote.1: Tani waa jawaab sidoo kale sheegaysa in wadarta b iyo d oo keliya la hagaajiyay.

z-m-20-03.prereq.0: H1 ee hawshani wuxuu calaamadeeyaa heerka adkaanta iyo taageerada ee ururkan soo saarka oo keliya; maaha qoondayn fasal ee manhajka. U malee inaad taqaanid isku darka, ka jarista iyo ku dhufashada tibaax-badan ee dugsiga dhexe, qaababka ku dhufashada, iyo qaybinta aasaasiga ah.
z-m-20-03.title: Naqshadaynta tibaax darajo-4 ah oo ah wax-soo-saarka afar tibaax oo toosan
z-m-20-03.topic: Cambaarooynta iyo naqshadaynta tibaaxaha darajo-4 ah adigoo isticmaalaya beddel
z-m-20-03.goal: Isbarbar dhig qorshayaal u kala qaybinaya tibaax darajo-4 ah oo leh xirmo soo noqnoqota, naftaada naqshadee tibaaxo ah wax-soo-saarka afar tibaax oo toosan, oo sharax sababta shuruudaha loo baahan yahay.
z-m-20-03.material: Tibaaxda (x²+x)²−8(x²+x)+12 waxaa loo qori karaa wax-soo-saarka afar tibaax oo toosan oo leh isku-dhufashooyin tirooyin dhan ah (akhriska: labajibbaarka x labajibbaaran ku dar x, laga jaray 8 jeer x labajibbaaran ku dar x, ku dar 12). Way fiicantahay in isla tibaaxda toosan ay soo noqnoqoto. Tibaaxaha is-ekaanshaha dhexdooda (x²+x)²+m(x²+x)+n (m iyo n waa tirooyin dhan), waxaan rabnaa inaan helno qaar ah wax-soo-saarka afar tibaax oo toosan oo leh isku-dhufashooyin tirooyin dhan ah.
z-m-20-03.thinking.0: Soo dhex-saarista kuwa ansax ah dhowr qorshe oo xal ah
z-m-20-03.thinking.1: Naqshadaynta dhowr tibaax oo buuxiya xaddidaadyada
z-m-20-03.thinking.2: Guud-ka-dhigista iyo sharaxaadda shuruudda kala qaybinta
z-m-20-03.prereq.1: Cambaarooynta tibaaxaha labajibbaarka ah ee qaabka x²+px+q (ka fikirka wadar iyo wax-soo-saar)
z-m-20-03.prereq.2: Khibrad beddelidda xirmo hal xarfo si loo eego tibaax
z-m-20-03.prereq.3: Macnaha tibaax toosan oo leh isku-dhufashooyin tirooyin dhan ah
z-m-20-03.s.s1.prompt: Dooro dhammaan qorshayaasha lagu gaari karo dhammaadka si loo qoro tibaaxda la bixiyey (x²+x)²−8(x²+x)+12 sida wax-soo-saarka tibaaxo toosan oo leh isku-dhufashooyin tirooyin dhan ah.
z-m-20-03.s.s1.hint.0: Qorshe kasta raac hal ama laba sadar oo hubi haddii afar tibaax oo toosan ay ugu dambayntii soo baxaan.
z-m-20-03.s.s1.hint.1: Marka aad isticmaasho habka gelinta dhowr qiime si aad u hubiso, ka fikir haddii kala duwanaanshaha qiimayaasha la tijaabiyey ku filan yahay iyo waxa ay noo sheegayso in 0 aanu soo bixin.
z-m-20-03.s.s1.o.a: Geli dhowr tiro oo dhan x, haddii 0 marna soo bixin, go'aami inaan la kala qaybin karin
z-m-20-03.s.s1.r.a: Waxaad ku gunaanatay inaan la kala qaybin karin sababtoo ah 0 ma soo bixin dhowr qiime. Waxaad seegi kartay musharrax, ama waxaad seegtay inay u kala qaybsami karto tibaaxo labajibbaaran halkii toosan.
z-m-20-03.s.s1.o.b: Ku beddel x²+x hal xarfo oo u kala qaybi sida tibaax labajibbaaran, kadibna mar kale eeg labada tibaax ee ka dhasha
z-m-20-03.s.s1.r.b: Kani waa qorshe xirmada soo noqnoqota u qaadanaya hal oo ku xalliya tallaabo-tallaabo.
z-m-20-03.s.s1.o.c: Qor (x−2)(x−6) oo ka dhig jawaabta adigoon dhigin x²+x meesha x
z-m-20-03.s.s1.r.c: Waxaad seegtay in x²+x ay tahay inay gasho meesha xirmada. Eeg meeshee waa in dib loo soo celiyo si tibaaxda labajibbaaran ee hal xarfo leh ay noqoto isla tibaaxdii asalka ahayd.
z-m-20-03.s.s1.o.d: Fidi dhammaan qaansooyinka si aad u hesho tibaax darajo-4 ah, kadibna geli qaybiyayaasha 12 oo ka bilow kuwa siinaya 0
z-m-20-03.s.s1.r.d: Kani waa qorshe si habaysan u tijaabinaya musharraxiinta cambaarooyinka tibaaxda la fidiyey.
z-m-20-03.s.s1.explain: Labada b iyo d waa lagu gaari karaa dhammaadka. b wuxuu u kala qaybsamaa wax sida (A−2)(A−6), kadibna wuxuu soo celiyaa A=x²+x oo mar kale u kala qaybiyaa, d na wuxuu u xalliyaa sida tibaax darajo-4 ah oo wuxuu heli doonaa cambaarooyinka mid-mid isagoo isticmaalaya aragtida cambaarooyinka. a ma tijaabin dhammaan musharraxiinta, c na ma soo celin xarafka.
z-m-20-03.s.s2.prompt: Hel laba lammaane oo tirooyin dhan ah oo kala duwan (m, n) oo (x²+x)²+m(x²+x)+n uu yahay wax-soo-saarka afar tibaax oo toosan oo leh isku-dhufashooyin tirooyin dhan ah. Si kastaba ha ahaatee, n maaha 0, oo ka reeb (m, n)=(−8, 12) ee kor ku xusan.
z-m-20-03.s.s2.hint.0: U qaad x²+x sida hal xarfo, dooro p iyo q si ay u qaadato qaabka (xarfahaas−p)(xarfahaas−q), kadibna hel m=−(p+q) iyo n=pq.
z-m-20-03.s.s2.hint.1: P iyo q aad dooratay, si gooni ah u hubi haddii x²+x−p iyo x²+x−q mid walba u kala qaybsamaan laba tibaax oo toosan oo leh isku-dhufashooyin tirooyin dhan ah.
z-m-20-03.s.s2.ok.c1: m iyo n waa tirooyin dhan.
z-m-20-03.s.s2.fail.c1: Fadlan m iyo n u qaado tirooyin dhan.
z-m-20-03.s.s2.ok.c2: Tibaaxda labajibbaaran ee x²+x u qaadata hal xarfo waxay buuxisaa shuruudda kala-soocaha ee leh xididdo tirooyin dhan ah.
z-m-20-03.s.s2.fail.c2: Tibaaxda labajibbaaran ee x²+x u qaadata hal xarfo ma u kala qaybsamo laba tibaax oo toosan oo leh isku-dhufashooyin tirooyin dhan ah.
z-m-20-03.s.s2.ok.c3: Tibaaxdaas labajibbaaran waxay u kala qaybsamaysaa laba tibaax oo leh isku-dhufashooyin tirooyin dhan ah.
z-m-20-03.s.s2.fail.c3: Tibaaxdaas labajibbaaran ma u kala qaybsamo laba tibaax oo leh isku-dhufashooyin tirooyin dhan ah.
z-m-20-03.s.s2.ok.c4: Labada tibaax ee la kala qaybiyey mar kale ayay u kala qaybsamaan tibaaxo toosan oo leh isku-dhufashooyin tirooyin dhan ah.
z-m-20-03.s.s2.fail.c4: Ugu yaraan mid ka mid ah labada tibaax ee kala qaybinta koowaad ma u kala qaybsamo laba tibaax oo toosan oo leh isku-dhufashooyin tirooyin dhan ah.
z-m-20-03.s.s2.ok.c6: Waa ka duwan yahay tusaalaha la bixiyey.

z-m-20-03.s.s2.explain: Tusaale ahaan, haddii (m, n)=(−14, 24), markaas (x²+x−2)(x²+x−12)=(x+2)(x−1)(x+4)(x−3), haddii (−18, 72) na, (x²+x−6)(x²+x−12)=(x+3)(x−2)(x+4)(x−3). Haddii (−4, 4), markaas (x²+x−2)²=(x+2)²(x−1)². (−5, 6) wuxuu u kala qaybsamaa (x²+x−2)(x²+x−3), laakiin x²+x−3 mar dambe ma u kala qaybsamo tibaaxo toosan oo leh isku-dhufashooyin tirooyin dhan ah.
z-m-20-03.s.s3.prompt: Haddii (m, n)=(−4, 3), wuxuu u kala qaybsamaa (x²+x−3)(x²+x−1). Ma x²+x−3 kuwan dhexdooda wuxuu u kala qaybsamaa wax-soo-saarka laba tibaax oo toosan oo leh isku-dhufashooyin tirooyin dhan ah? Ka jawaab "waa u kala qaybsamaa" ama "ma u kala qaybsamo" oo qor sababta.
z-m-20-03.s.s3.hint.0: Ha noqdo x²+x−3=(x+u)(x+v) oo qor sida isku-dhufashada x iyo erayga joogtada ah u soo baxaan marka u iyo v lagu muujiyo marka aad fidiso dhinaca midig.
z-m-20-03.s.s3.hint.1: Liis ka dhig dhammaan lammaanayaasha tirooyinka dhan ee wax-soo-saarkoodu yahay −3, hel wadarka mid walba, oo hubi haddii mid ka mid ah uu yahay 1.
z-m-20-03.s.s3.selfAssess.0: Ma qortay waxa u+v iyo uv mid walba ay tahay inay noqdaan marka lagu qoro qaabka (x+u)(x+v)?
z-m-20-03.s.s3.selfAssess.1: Ma qortay haddii aad raadisay tirooyin dhan u iyo v noocaas ah (ama aad bixisay sabab kale, sida kala-soocaha)?
z-m-20-03.s.s3.selfAssess.2: Ma sheegtay haddii gunaanadka "ma shaqeeyo" uu ka yimid hubinta dhowr musharrax ama shuruud qaar?
z-m-20-03.s.s3.model.0: Ma u kala qaybsamo. Haddii aan u qorno (x+u)(x+v), waxaan u baahannahay u+v=1 iyo uv=−3, laakiin lammaanayaasha tirooyinka dhan ee wax-soo-saarkoodu yahay −3 waa (1, −3) iyo (−1, 3) oo keliya, wadarradooduna waa −2 iyo 2, sidaa darteed ma heli karno 1.
z-m-20-03.s.s3.model.1: Mar dambe ma u kala qaybsamo isku-dhufashooyin tirooyin dhan ah. Kala-soocaha x²+x−3=0 waa 1+12=13, 13 na maaha labajibbaar qumman, sidaa darteed xididdadu ma aha tirooyin dhan ama jajabyo, markaas ma loo qori karo wax-soo-saarka laba tibaax oo toosan oo leh isku-dhufashooyin tirooyin dhan ah.
z-m-20-03.s.s3.modelNote.1: Sharaxaad adigoo kala-soocaha isticmaalaya sidoo kale waa ansax.
z-m-20-03.s.s3.model.2: Marka p=2, waxaa jira u=2 iyo v=−1 oo wadarkoodu yahay 1 wax-soo-saarkoodu na yahay −2, sidaa darteed wuu u kala qaybsamaa. Laakiin 3, lammaane tirooyin dhan ah oo wax-soo-saarkoodu yahay −3 wadarkoodu na yahay 1 ma jiro, sidaa darteed ma u kala qaybsamo. Sidaa darteed waxay u egtahay in p ay tahay inay noqoto wax-soo-saarka laba tiro oo dhan oo isku xigta, sida 2, 6, 12, si ay u kala qaybsanto.
z-m-20-03.s.s3.model.3: Ma loo qaybin karo. Gelinta qaybiyayaasha erayga joogtada ah −3, 1, −1, 3, −3, 0 ma siiso.

z-m-20-04.title: Qiimaha tibaax leh tiro aan-saami ahayn la geliyey ma tiro aan-saami ahayn?
z-m-20-04.topic: Qiimaha iyo hadhaaga tibaax leh tiro aan-saami ahayn la geliyey
z-m-20-04.goal: Ku hubi xisaabin in qiimaha tibaax saddex-jibbaar ah oo leh tiro aan-saami ahayn la geliyey uu noqon karo tiro dhan, oo samee tibaax kale oo leh qiime 4 isla sabab.
z-m-20-04.material: Waxaan rabnaa inaan helno qiimaha E=x³−3x²−3x+5 marka x=2+√3. Akhriska: x waa "2 ku dar xididka 3" x³ na waa "x saddexjibbaaran". Xisaabiye ma isticmaalno. √3 waa tiro togan oo labajibbaarkeedu yahay 3, lamana qori karo sida jajab. Macluumaadka hal-hal ayaa loo muujiyaa, sidaa darteed mar kasta dooro waxa aad u malaysay inuu hadda ugu habboon yahay.
z-m-20-04.thinking.0: Dib u eegista qiyaastaada ka hor xisaabinta mar kasta oo macluumaad badan soo baxo
z-m-20-04.thinking.2: Naqshadaynta dhowr tibaax oo leh isla sifo
z-m-20-04.prereq.1: Xaqiiqada ah √3×√3=3 iyo √3 lama qori karo sida jajab
z-m-20-04.prereq.2: Isku-darka, ka jarida iyo isku-dhufashada tirooyinka qaabka (a+b√3)
z-m-20-04.prereq.3: Macnaha qaybsame iyo hadhaaga marka tibaax loo qaybiyo tibaax (tibaaxda qaybinta A=BQ+R)
z-m-20-04.s.s1.prompt: Mar kasta oo macluumaad la muujiyo, dooro waxa aad ka malaysay qiimaha E.
z-m-20-04.s.s1.hint.0: Tallaabo kasta, qor ilaa xaggee ayaad tagi kartaa xisaabinta la yaqaan oo keliya.
z-m-20-04.s.s1.hint.1: Tijaabi hadallada leh "waa inay" ama "marna" doorashooyinka dhexdooda adigoo isticmaalaya tusaalayaal lid ku ah ama xisaabin.
z-m-20-04.s.s1.st.0.info: x waa tiro aan-saami ahayn 2+√3, E na wuxuu leeyahay erayo halka x lagu dhufto dhowr jeer (x³, x²). Waxa aad ilaa hadda xisaabisay waa x²=(2+√3)²=7+4√3.
z-m-20-04.s.s1.st.0.ask: Qaabkee ayaad u malaysaa inuu qiimaha E qaadanayo?
